description: Follow a build publish_app started: its state, the log it has written so far, and, once it succeeds, the release it produced and the URL that now serves it. Poll every ten to fifteen seconds until the state is terminal; most builds finish within five minutes. A failed build's log is where the reason is, usually a missing dependency or a start command that exited. Requires connecting a Valet account.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the build belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: get_build
title: Get a build
